description: Screenshot every web variant at the same moments after it's ready, in a fresh headless Chromium (real GPU), and save PNGs in a new timestamped folder inside outDir. Use it to check each variant still looks right: open the files and compare them side by side with the baseline. Use the same params (e.g. the same count and pattern) for every case. Animated scenes differ by timing, so compare shapes, colors, glow and layout, and take several moments to catch frozen or broken motion.

atMs.description: Times after ready to capture, in ms. Default [500, 2000].

outDir.description: Folder to save the PNGs in.

name: screenshot_web_variants
